title: Schedule of Ancillary Quote Charges - Customer-Pay Repairs Shop Supplies, Hazardous Waste and Mobile Service
content:
This schedule sets, for each Customer-Pay Repairs service tier, the three charges that sit on a quote beside labor, refinish and parts: the shop supplies charge and its ceiling, the flat hazardous waste disposal fee, and the fee for doing the work at the customer's location.

## Schedule

| Service tier | Shop supplies (percent of quoted labor) | Shop supplies cap per repair order (USD) | Hazardous waste fee (USD, flat) | Mobile service available | Mobile service fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paintless Dent Repair Service | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | Yes | 25.00 |
| Cosmetic Touch-Up Service | 5 | 25.00 | 4.95 | Yes | 25.00 |
| Bumper Refinish Service | 6 | 35.00 | 6.95 | No | 0.00 |
| Panel Repair Service | 6 | 45.00 | 6.95 | No | 0.00 |
| Customer-Pay Collision Service | 6 | 60.00 | 9.95 | No | 0.00 |
| Complete Refinish Service | 8 | 85.00 | 14.95 | No | 0.00 |

## Terms as defined in the Customer-Pay Repairs charter

- **Shop supplies percentage**: Shop supplies charge as a percentage of quoted labor (percent).
- **Shop supplies cap**: Most the shop supplies charge can be on one repair order (USD).
- **Hazardous waste fee**: Flat hazardous waste disposal fee on the quote (USD).
- **Mobile service available**: Whether the work can be done at the customer's location (boolean).
- **Mobile service fee**: Fee for doing the work at the customer's location (USD).

## Notes to the schedule

1. The shop supplies charge is the tier's percentage of quoted labor, and it never exceeds the tier's cap on one repair order. For the Cosmetic Touch-Up Service the charge is 5 percent of quoted labor up to 25.00; for the Complete Refinish Service, 8 percent up to 85.00.
2. The Paintless Dent Repair Service carries no shop supplies charge (0 percent, cap 0.00) and no hazardous waste fee (0.00).
3. Only the Paintless Dent Repair Service and the Cosmetic Touch-Up Service offer mobile service, each at 25.00. The four other tiers show "No" and a 0.00 fee.

## Illustrations (hypothetical quoted labor amounts)

| Tier | Hypothetical quoted labor | Percentage applied | Before the cap | Shop supplies charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cosmetic Touch-Up Service | 300.00 | 5 percent | 15.00 | 15.00 (below the 25.00 cap) |
| Cosmetic Touch-Up Service | 600.00 | 5 percent | 30.00 | 25.00 (held at the cap) |
| Customer-Pay Collision Service | 1,000.00 | 6 percent | 60.00 | 60.00 (exactly at the cap) |
| Customer-Pay Collision Service | 2,000.00 | 6 percent | 120.00 | 60.00 (held at the cap) |
